title: Malicious code in fca-uzair-dev (npm)
description: The npm package fca-uzair-dev version 1.2.0 contains malicious code that exfiltrates Facebook login credentials, including email, password, and the long-lived Base32 two-factor authentication seed, to a hardcoded external server. It also auto-updates itself from an unpinned GitHub repository, allowing arbitrary code execution on the consumer's machine upon library load.
